_README: FEVER BLACK FRIDAY BADGE (Sofia 2026-11-10). SWITCHED OFF: enabled is false and plans is empty, so no badge can appear. To arm it, ALL of: (1) paste Isla Vilches's definitive list into plans (one entry per Fever plan, sku = the number in feverup.com/m/<sku>); (2) check campaign_start/campaign_end; (3) set enabled to true (the JSON value true, not the text "true"); (4) push. To switch off again: set enabled to false and push, or set env FEVER_PROMO_OFF=1 on the box. It switches itself off after campaign_end. A badge shows only for a listed sku, only inside the campaign window (and the plan's own from/to if given); if a plan has "dates" it shows only on those dates (main calendar cards; shelf tiles have no date so a plan with "dates" gets no shelf badge). The badge text is 'Up to 30% off on Fever' in 8 languages (override per plan with "label": {"en": "..."}). Never print a discounted price: only Fever's own page knows it. ARMED 2026-11-18 with the 10 Candlelight plans Fever's Malaga Black Friday page shows discounted that day. RE-CHECK FRI 20 NOV (early sales open for other experiences) and Fri 27 Nov (BF weekend); add plans then; campaign ends 30 Nov.
